general: Neutorium is a research-led digital studio. We partner with up to fifteen companies per industry and build the website, premium films and inquiry system that turn their work into clients, over a 90-day engagement.

We research a company's market, then build its digital presence: a fast portfolio website, premium short reels and long-form films, a content calendar, and an inquiry and follow-up system. Long-term partners add SEO, AEO and custom AI agents.
Which industries does Neutorium work with?
We work one industry at a time and are currently partnering with interior design studios, residential and commercial. New industries open as we grow, each with fifteen partner seats.
How long does a partnership take?
The core engagement is 90 days in three phases: a live website by Day 30, a verified inquiry system by Day 60, and every contracted asset delivered by Day 90.
How do I start a project with Neutorium?
Use the project builder at neutorium.com/start to choose a partnership package or individual services. We reply within two working days.
partnership: Why only fifteen partners per industry?

Fifteen is the most we can serve with real attention while the research still compounds. Monthly production capacity also limits how many new partners start each month. When seats are full, new companies join a waiting list.

The right package depends on your numbers. On a short call we look at your monthly inquiries and average project value together, then talk about fees. We never lower the price for the same scope; a smaller budget means a smaller package.
Do you guarantee clients or revenue?
No. We guarantee delivery: every asset in the signed scope arrives within 90 days, or we keep working at no additional fee until it does. Results are tracked openly against your Day-14 baseline.
Not in the first 90 days. First we learn which content works and make sure inquiries are handled well; then ads scale what is already proven. Ad spend is always separate.
You do. Final videos, website content and your domain are yours after full payment. We only show the work in our portfolio with your written consent.
Monthly. The first month is paid before kickoff, the second and third on Day 31 and Day 61.
services: Can I hire a single service without a partnership?
Yes. Every service can be hired on its own with a fixed scope and timeline. If it later grows into a partnership, the work carries over.
Can I combine services into my own package?
Yes. Pick what you need in the project builder and we come back with a scope, timeline and fee for that combination.
Do single services get the same research?
Every project starts with a short research brief, scaled to its size. The standard of work does not change with scope.
Two rounds per asset as standard. Further rounds are agreed in writing before they start.

exampleArticle.title: What is answer engine optimisation (AEO)?
exampleArticle.question: What is answer engine optimisation (AEO)?
exampleArticle.answer: Answer engine optimisation (AEO) is the practice of making a business easy for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews to understand, trust and quote. It combines crawlable pages, consistent business facts, structured data and content that answers real questions directly.
exampleArticle.author: Neutorium
exampleArticle.body:
## How is AEO different from SEO?

SEO aims for a high position in a list of links. AEO aims to be the source an assistant quotes or recommends in its answer. The foundations overlap: a fast, crawlable website and helpful content. AEO adds a stronger focus on clear entities, short direct answers and evidence that other sites mention you.

## What do answer engines look for?

- Pages they can read without running JavaScript
- The same business facts on the website and every profile
- A direct answer near the top of the page
- Structured data that labels services, questions and answers
- Independent mentions, reviews and original data

## Where should a company start?

Start by checking how assistants answer the questions your buyers ask today, then fix crawlability and business facts before writing new content.

faqs.question: Does AEO replace SEO?
faqs.answer: No. AEO builds on SEO. Most answer engines use search indexes, so a site that is not indexed and trusted will rarely be quoted.

faqs.question: How long does AEO take?
faqs.answer: Technical fixes can be done in weeks. Being cited consistently usually takes several months of publishing answer-first content and earning mentions.
